$comment: Template profiles as data, so a template is a manifest rather than a static list inside the
platform. Each entry declares three independent things:
content     - seed packs whose rows are seeded once into a site.
composition - the modules the template is built from. A BUILD-TIME fact: a published site
should ship only these, not every module plus a flag saying which are on.
defaults    - settings this template seeds; the owner edits them afterwards. Values are a
product decision, which is why this is empty rather than invented.
Only packs in SeedPackNames.All may be listed. An unknown name fails the profile tests.
Override this file without rebuilding by pointing Templates:ProfilesPath at another copy.

profiles.purpose: Neutral starting point: the community shell only.
Adult dating club. Interest tags and VIP tiers are the point.
Members-only premium club. VIP tiers, chat and video.
Social community. Forum, chat, messages and video.
Commerce front. The community shell; products come from the owner.
Corporate portal. Content, pages, forums and a store; no dating, no IPTV.
Business and professional networking, with a store.
Editorial publication. Blog-led, with pages and discussion.
Content-first reading site. Blog and pages, nothing else.
Gaming community. Chat, events, gamification and leaderboards.
Streaming service. Subscription plans and a support forum.
Business portal: services, publishing, a storefront and contact. No dating, no IPTV, no membership tiers.
